purpose: Evaluate evidence grading, scope control, traceability separation, and safe wording.

cases.task: Audit a causal manuscript statement supported only by association and enrichment.
must_include: claim decomposed into observation and causal interpretation

cases.task: Assess a clinical-validation claim based on database annotations and trial registration.
must_not: equate database association with approved indication

cases.task: Audit a claim whose figure exists but whose plotted source file is missing.
must_include: scientific support assessed from available material
must_not: declare the observation false solely because provenance is missing

cases.task: Assess a prediction-accuracy claim in a mappability-sensitive interval.
must_include: model prediction and observed signal separated
must_not: call concordance accuracy without a defined truth metric
merge strict and relaxed mapping evidence

cases.task: Audit three abstract claims when only the abstract, one figure, and one table are available.
